latvia.description: Gianni Infantino azt tervezte, hogy a FIFA-tornák egyes részesedéseit magánbefektetőknek adják el, de az ötlet nem aratott osztatlan sikert. Most bocsánatot is kért miatta.

latvia.title: Elnyerte a demokraták szenátorjelöltségét a muszlim, egyiptomi gyökerű Abdul El-Sayed
latvia.description: Az orvos végzettségű 44 éves jelölt lehet az Egyesült Államok első muszlim vallású szenátora, ha győz a novemberi félidős választáson.

latvia.title: Bocsánatot kért Gianni Infantino, amiért kiárusította volna a világbajnokságot
latvia.description: Hibának nevezte saját tervét a FIFA elnöke, aki egyelőre marad a szervezet élén.

latvia.title: Rémálom a repülőn: 90 métert zuhant a levegőben egy indiai utasszállító
latvia.description: Legalább 12-en megsérültek, az utastérben burkolati elemek szakadtak le, kitört a pánik. A rémület utáni pillanatokról videó is készült.

latvia.title: Valerij Zaluzsnijt megkérték, hogy magyarázza meg, amit a NATO-ról mondott, erre elmondta ugyanazt, csak még erősebben
latvia.description: „A NATO még mindig a második világháború végén kialakított doktrína szerint működik, miközben technológiai szempontból már előrébb járunk.”

latvia.title: „Mondtam a miniszternek, hogy ugyanilyen gőzössel jártam annak idején dolgozni”
latvia.description: Három év szünet után újra járnak személyvonatok Komlóra, pedig a város polgármestere korábban a vasútvonal városon belüli szakaszának elbontásáért lobbizott. Bár Vitézy Dávid szimbolikus projektként kezeli az újranyitást, Polics József nem tett le a vasútmentes belvárosról.

latvia.title: Zelenszkij rendkívüli segítséget kér a NATO-tól: minden nap emberéletek múlnak rajta - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index csütörtöki hírösszefoglalója
latvia.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index csütörtöki hírösszefoglalója.

latvia.title: Veszélyes orosz játék a levegőben: példátlanul megugrott a katonai riasztások száma a NATO keleti határán
latvia.description: A NATO keleti szárnyán júliusban több mint két és félszeresére nőtt a vadászgépek riasztásainak száma az előző év azonos időszakához képest – derül ki a szövetség kelet- és közép-európai egyesített erőinek augusztus 5-i jelentéséből. A növekedés hátterében az orosz katonai repülőgépek egyre gyakoribb, repülési terv és transzponder nélküli megjelenése áll a NATO-tagállamok légterének közelében - közölte a Kyiv Independent .

latvia.title: Összeesküvést gyanít Zelenszkij: szövetkeztek Ukrajna ellen a NATO tagállamai?
latvia.description: Elképzelhető, hogy Ukrajna szövetségesei nyomást akarnak gyakorolni Kijevre azzal, hogy szándékosan nem szállítanak több légvédelmi rakétát - mondta Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök az Ukrinform cikke szerint.

latvia.title: Súlyos incidens történt egy NATO-bázison: hajszál híján múlt a katasztrófa, ez akár szándékos támadás is lehet
latvia.description: A lipcsei repülőtéren kedden késő este talált drón robbanószerkezettel volt felszerelve - közölték a német nyomozóhatóságok.

latvia.title: Znaczny wzrost liczby przechwyceń rosyjskich samolotów nad wschodnią flanką NATO
latvia.description: Włoski kontyngent, chwilę po przejęciu misji po siłach powietrznych Francji, był zmuszony do interwencji nad Bałtykiem. W ciągu roku liczba poderwań myśliwców NATO do przechwycenia rosyjskich samolotów wzdłuż wschodniej flanki Sojuszu wzrosła o ponad 250 procent - poinformowało Dowództwo Połączonych Sił Powietrznych NATO.

latvia.title: Česko je logistický uzol NATO, no jeho bojové vozidlá parkujú desiatky kilometrov od svojej základne
latvia.description: Napriek vyšším výdavkom na obranu zostávajú kľúčové slabiny českej armády prakticky nezmenené, ukazujú dokumenty ministerstva obrany aj kontrolné správy.

latvia.title: Ukrajina nikdy nevstúpi do NATO, povedal Zalužnyj. Ako chápať vyjadrenie bývalého šéfa ukrajinskej armády?
latvia.description: Ukrajinské ministerstvo zahraničných vecí odkázalo, že cieľom Kyjiva je naďalej vstup do Aliancie.

latvia.title: Trei factori care pot amâna instalarea demenţei. Descoperirile făcute de un nou studiu
latvia.description: Oamenii de ştiinţă susţin că au identificat trei factori de sănătate la vârsta mijlocie care pot amâna instalarea demenţei pentru mai bine de un deceniu. Conform unui studiu, menţinerea unei tensiuni arteriale normale, absenţa diabetului de tip 2 şi renunţarea la fumat între vârstele de 45 şi 65 de ani au fost asociate, în medie, cu aproape 13 ani suplimentari de viaţă fără demenţă.

latvia.title: Valeri Zalujnîi spune ca de fapt NATO are nevoie de Ucraina: „Să spună sincer, poate lupta cu Rusia fără experiența noastră?”
latvia.description: Ambasadorul Ucrainei în Regatul Unit, fostul comandant-şef al Forţelor Armate ale Ucrainei, Valeri Zalujnîi, a dat miercuri explicații cu privire la declarația sa de acum două zile, când a spus că Ucraina nu ar fi avantajată de aderarea la NATO, relatează Evropeiska Pravda şi Interfax-Ucraina.

latvia.title: Volodimir Zelenski, discuție cu șeful NATO. Despre ce au vorbit cei doi lideri: „Este bine informat cu privire la amenințări”
latvia.description: Președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski a declarat miercuri că a discutat cu secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, despre posibilitatea de a obține mai multe rachete de interceptare pentru apărarea aeriană, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Spania se teme pentru exclavele Ceuta și Melilla. Cine ar sări în ajutorul Madridului în cazul unei acțiuni a Marocului
latvia.description: Valul de migranți care a ajuns în exclavele spaniole Ceuta și Melilla a reaprins temerile Madridului privind securitatea teritoriilor sale din Africa de Nord. În contextul în care Marocul își intensifică revendicările asupra celor două orașe autonome, oficialii spanioli se întreabă cât de solid ar fi sprijinul aliaților din NATO și al Statelor Unite în cazul unei escaladări a tensiunilor, arată Politico, într-o analiză.

latvia.title: Incident de securitate: o dronă a zburat în apropierea unui avion ucrainean pe aeroportul din Leipzig/Halle
latvia.description: La scurt timp după miezul nopții, o alertă de securitate a fost declanșată pe aeroportul Leipzig/Halle. O dronă fusese observată în incintă. Mai multe detalii au apărut acum: potrivit unui purtător de cuvânt al NATO, o dronă a fost observată în apropierea unei aeronave ucrainene, relatează focus.de.

latvia.title: Ucraina așteaptă undă verde din partea SUA pentru producția rachetelor Patriot. Washingtonul ezită
latvia.description: Rafalele de rachete balistice lansate de Rusia au determinat Kievul să încerce cu disperare să înceapă producția propriilor rachete de interceptare Patriot, însă, în ciuda acordului inițial al lui Trump pentru o licență de producție, SUA nu au oferit încă nicio certitudine. Este puțin probabil ca Statele Unite să ajungă la un acord cu Ucraina privind producția comună de rachete de interceptare Patriot înainte de această iarnă, a declarat luni ambasadorul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, alimentând incertitudinea cu privire la cel mai critic aspect al apărării aeriene a Kievului, arată Euronews.

latvia.title: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei ucrainene solicită demiterea comandantului Forțelor Medicale. „Omul lui Sîrskîi”
latvia.description: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei Ucrainei, Mihailo Drapatîi, a înaintat o cerere prin care solicită demiterea lui Anatolii Kazmirchuk, comandantul Forțelor Medicale.

latvia.title: Abrudean, apel către senatori: De votul pe legea integrității și strategia pentru biodiversitate depind 3,48 miliarde de euro din PNRR
latvia.description: Președintele Senatului Mircea Abrudean le cere senatorilor să adopte în această săptămână proiectele privind strategia națională pentru biodiversitate și legea integrității. Liberalul avertizează că de îndeplinirea acestor jaloane din Planul Național de Redresare și Reziliență (PNRR) depinde accesarea a aproximativ 3,48 miliarde de euro.

latvia.title: Consilierul pe securitate națională de la Cotroceni și șeful Armatei au fost primiți la Pentagon. Mesaj privind NATO 3.0
latvia.description: Subsecretarul de stat de la Departamentul de Război al Statelor Unite, Elbridge Colby, a anunțat marți că a avut o întrevedere la Pentagon cu consilierul pentru securitate națională de la Cotroceni, Marius Lazurca, căruia i-a prezentat în avans abordarea SUA privind „Europe Posture Review”. La întrunire a participat și șeful Armatei României, generalul Gheorghiță Vlad.

latvia.title: Tanczos Barna: S-a format o majoritate ciudată pentru legea ANI. E inadmisibil să facem amendamente cu țintă la o persoană
latvia.description: Legea ANI, adoptată luni de Camera Deputaţilor şi aflată pe ordinea de zi a sesiunea extraordinare a Senatului, care e Cameră decizională, a devenit „un concurs de mesaje politice şi mai puţin un act de legiferare bine gândit”, a declarat marți, la RFI, vicepremierul Tanczos Barna. „E inadmisibil să facem legi pe persoane fizice”, mai declară senatorul UDMR.

latvia.title: Un pilot ucrainean a urmărit racheta rusească de tip KH-101 care a explodat în Polonia. De ce nu a doborât-o
latvia.description: Un pilot al Forțelor Aeriene Ucrainene, care se afla în „urmărire directă” a unei rachete rusești de tip Kh-101 care s-a prăbușit în Polonia în luna iulie, a fost nevoit să se întoarcă la graniță din cauza procedurilor NATO, a dezvăluit viceministrul polonez al Apărării, relatează TVPWorld.

latvia.title: Cum explică Cosmin Marinescu, viceguvernator al BNR, reconfirmarea ratingului României de către Fitch
latvia.description: Viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu susține că decizia agenției Fitch de a reconfirma ratingul de țară al României este justificată de evoluția principalilor indicatori macroeconomici. Într-o postare publicată pe site-ul său, acesta a invocat reducerea deficitului bugetar, perspectiva de scădere a inflației, estimările privind revenirea creșterii economice, nivelul rezervelor internaționale și soliditatea sistemului bancar drept principalele argumente care au stat la baza evaluării agenției de rating.

latvia.title: Estonia returns first illegal migrants to Latvia
latvia.description: Eight migrants from Ethiopia found in Estonia after illegally entering the European Union via the Latvia-Belarus border were handed over to the Latvian border guard on Wednesday.

latvia.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Ukraina valis endale Vene armeest hävitamiseks väga keerulise sihtmärgi
latvia.description: Ukraina president teatas, et Ukraina sõjaväelaste eesmärk on hävitada Vene armee ballistiliste rakettide Iskander laskeseadeldised ning et Ukraina sõjaväelased teevad selleks ettevalmistusi, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

latvia.title: WSJ ⟩ Putin tuunib sõjamasinat, et tuure üles võtta
latvia.description: Venemaa president Vladimir Putin nimetas ametisse armee uue droonitiiva juhataja ning paigutas ringi käputäie komandöre olukorras, kus Moskva üritab elavdada oma jukerdavat kampaaniat Ukrainas.

latvia.title: Latvia to practice military mobilization this weekend
latvia.description: On Saturday, August 8, the National Armed Forces will deploy mobilization centers in several cities – Rīga, Kuldīga, Valmiera, and Alūksne.

latvia.title: Why does airBaltic want to employ its pilots via Switzerland?
latvia.description: A company established in non-EU Switzerland by the Latvian national airline airBaltic is still waiting for approval from the authorities to start its operations, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: Grain harvest varies regionally in Latvia
latvia.description: During these August days, farmers are making the most of every sunny moment to harvest their grain. Farmers are pleased that most of the grain they have grown – at least under the current conditions – is of a higher quality, and many have managed to harvest food-grade wheat, Latvian Radio reported on August 6.

latvia.title: 'missionLatvia' grinds to a halt; another image in the works
latvia.description: The Latvian Investment and Development Agency (LIAA) is seeking, through a tender process, a contractor to develop another strategy for Latvia’s national image, Latvian Radio reports on August 6.

latvia.title: Dāvis Bertāns ends career in Latvian national basketball team
latvia.description: Dāvis Bertāns has brought his career with the Latvian national basketball team to a close, the Latvian Basketball Association (LBS) announced on Wednesday.

latvia.title: Heat alert in force in eastern Latvia Thursday
latvia.description: On Thursday, a heat warning will be in force across central and eastern Latvia, including Riga, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 5th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Frosty meeting between Latvian government and NGOs
latvia.description: A meeting between Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) and non-governmental organisations (NGOs) was not a constructive dialogue, according to representatives of the organisations. The government will continue to criticise NGO funding.

latvia.title: Now Rīga Airport border control experiences 'technical issues'
latvia.description: Following days of delays at the Latvia-Belarus border due to IT system glitches, on Wednesday, August 5th it was the turn of Riga Airport to experience "technical issues".

latvia.title: Monthly fuel prices down 3.5% in Latvia
latvia.description: The data from the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB), published on August 5, show that in July 2026, compared to June 2026, the average level of consumer prices of fuels for transport decreased by 3.5 %.

latvia.title: Conscripts might be sent to patrol Latvia's eastern border in future
latvia.description: The situation on the Latvian-Belarusian border has become serious, and the State Border Guard needs additional human resources to guard it, Deputy Chief of the State Border Guard, General Juris Martukāns, said on the Latvian Radio programme "Krustpunktā" (At the crossroads) on August 5th.

latvia.title: Tobacco use still pretty popular in Latvia
latvia.description: In 2025, 16.5% of people 16 years or older in the EU used tobacco and related products (e-cigarettes, nicotine pouches or heated tobacco products) daily, indicating a slight decrease from the 17.5% registered in 2022. Most people (77.5%) do not use such products or had not used them in the 12 months prior to the data collection.

latvia.title: Moscow-based Latvian scammer group detained
latvia.description: On 3 August this year, the State Police’s Cybercrime Combating Administration concluded their investigation into the activities of an organised criminal group – phone scammers who, whilst based in Moscow, Russia, defrauded several Latvian residents between May and September 2025, police said.

latvia.title: Anti-mobility drills to take place in Rīga on Friday
latvia.description: On Friday, 7 August, a practical exercise will take place on Ojāra Vācieša Street in Rīga, during which Rīga City Council, together with its partners, will construct anti-mobility engineering structures – physical barriers designed to slow the movement of enemy forces in an urban environment, the city council said.

latvia.title: Urgent repairs required at Balvi swimming pool
latvia.description: The Balvi municipality urgently needs to find at least 80,000 euros to repair the local swimming pool.

latvia.title: Latvian government hopes to close business address loophole
latvia.description: At the Cabinet meeting on August 4th, Minister of Justice Edvards Smiltēns raised a significant problem: the dishonest registration of legal addresses of businesses on property owned by another person without the knowledge and consent of the owner of that property.

latvia.title: Blood donors urged to come forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Donor activity traditionally declines in the summer but at the same time, the number of injuries rises, planned and emergency operations take place, and the treatment of cancer and other patients continues – all of which require blood every single day. The State Blood Donor Centre is urging potential donors to come donate.

latvia.title: Latvian Minister in the soup after lecturing Spain on immigration
latvia.description: Latvian Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) appears to have annoyed key EU and NATO partner Spain, reports Latvian Television.

latvia.title: Extortion case goes to prosecution in Latgale, Latvia
latvia.description: The State Police in Latgale are recommending that four people be charged with extortion and other serious crimes in Kārsava, Ludza municipality, police said on August 5.

latvia.title: Hot Wednesday ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts suggest that the weather in Latvia will become hotter on Wednesday, according to weatherman Toms Bricis.

latvia.title: Latvian State Security Service looks at violent AI video
latvia.description: The State Security Service is investigating a video of boxer Kristaps Zutis, published on the ‘X’ platform, which was created using artificial intelligence. It shows scenes of violence against third-country citizens, including crude and cruel treatment of food delivery workers.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 4th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Latvia's 'national position' on Russia and Belarus is to step up sanctions
latvia.description: On 4th August, the Latvian cabinet approved what it dubbed the country's "national position" with regard to aggressor states Russia and Belarus.

latvia.title: Latvia-Belarus border will not be closed completely
latvia.description: The Latvian-Belarusian border will not be closed for the time being, the government decided on Tuesday, 4 August, during a closed-door meeting, Latvian Radio reported.

latvia.title: Six-year-old missing from Rīga found
latvia.description: The State Police reported Tuesday evening that six-year-old Daniels Volkovs, who had gone missing, had been found.

latvia.title: Millions invested in digitalisation, but is productivity keeping pace?
latvia.description: According to the European Commission, Latvia ranks fourth among EU Member States in the digitalisation of public services.

latvia.title: Latvian industry ticked up in June
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau calendar adjusted data (at constant prices) published on August 4th show that in June 2026 industrial production output in Latvia increased by 0.5 % year on year.

latvia.title: Tere, naaber! Estonian Days are coming to northern Latvia
latvia.description: Later this month, Latvia's northern Valmiera region will be extending a warm welcome to visitors from even further north with the first ever 'Estonian Days' due to take place.

latvia.title: Street in Rīga closed due to dilapidated building
latvia.description: To prevent any potential risk to public safety, vehicle traffic has been closed and pedestrian access restricted from 3 August at the unoccupied building at 8 Daugavpils Street, Rīga,

latvia.title: It's fine to swim in Saldus Lake again
latvia.description: The Health Inspectorate has lifted the advice against swimming in Lake Saldus, the Inspectorate said on 4 August.

latvia.title: Latvian public media watchdog head re-elected
latvia.description: Sanita Upleja-Jegermane has been reappointed as chair of the Public Electronic Mass Media Council (SEPLP) for the next term, running from 4 August 2026 to 3 August 2027, the SEPLP announced.

latvia.title: Hockey coach in custody for alleged sexual abuse of minor
latvia.description: A coach at the “Ogres novada Lāči” children’s and youth ice hockey club has been arrested on suspicion of sexual abuse of a child during a camp, the State Police reported on August 4. Police are calling on other potential victims to come forward.

latvia.title: Estonian border guards head south to help Latvia
latvia.description: The Estonian Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) sent a third rotating unit to Latvia on Monday, August 3rd to help stop illegal migration on the Latvian-Belarusian border, reports ERR News.

latvia.title: Rīga bars try out new dating app
latvia.description: Eight bars in the Latvian capital Rīga, are trialling a new social interaction or dating app, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvia is in a strong position on water resources
latvia.description: Latvia's many lakes and rivers give it a strong portfolio of freshwater 'water resources' – an increasingly important thing in a drier, hotter world – according to latest Eurostat data.

latvia.title: Trash will be costlier in Liepāja and southwestern Latvia
latvia.description: In the South Kurzeme region and in Liepāja, household waste collection charges are set to rise twice this year, Latvian Radio reported on August 4.

latvia.title: Closure of Latvia-Belarus border point proposed
latvia.description: The Ministry of the Interior will ask the government to suspend operations at the ‘Pāternieki’ border crossing between Latvia and Belarus, according to a publicly available draft government decision from the ministry on August 3.

latvia.title: Possible Livonian castle site examined by archaeologists
latvia.description: The largest archaeological excavations to date are taking place at Grebu Hill Fort and the adjacent Grebu Bļodas Hill in Dikļu Parish, Valmiera Municipality. The first pottery shards have been found, and researchers hope to find the answer to a centuries-old question – whether this could be the site of the Livonian Metsepole Castle mentioned in written sources, Latvian Television reported on August 4.

latvia.title: Vītoliņš remains head coach of Latvia's national men's hockey team
latvia.description: The Latvian Ice Hockey Federation (LHF) has agreed with Harijs Vītoliņš, head coach of the men’s national ice hockey team, to continue their collaboration for another season, the LHF announced on Monday, August 3.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 3rd August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: airBaltic bondholder meeting fails to get off the ground
latvia.description: A meeting that was supposed to take place on Monday, August 3rd to decide the financial future of Latvian national airline airBaltic had to be postponed because not enough of the company's bondholders registered to attend it.

latvia.title: Number of burglaries dramatically down over the decade in Latvia
latvia.description: As summer holidays begin, police across the European Union are urging residents to take extra care to protect their homes against burglaries and break-ins.

latvia.title: Woman in Mārupe, Latvia accused of attempted murder of family
latvia.description: The State Police are requesting that a woman born in 1981 be charged with the attempted murder of two people – evidence gathered during the investigation suggests that on 8 December last year she poisoned her son and common-law husband with medication. The woman has been arrested, police said on August 3.

latvia.title: Latvia has 334 thousand children
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau data published on August 3, inhabitants aged 17 and under totalled 334 thousand at the beginning of 2026, accounting for 18.1 % of the country’s population.

latvia.title: Trucks stuck at Latvia-Belarus border
latvia.description: The “Pāternieki” border crossing with Belarus remains closed. It was closed due to technical faults in the information systems. Over the weekend, several lorry drivers were stranded there, unable to process their documents, Latvian Radio reported on August 3.

latvia.title: Top tick myths busted by Latvian researcher
latvia.description: In the summer, along with going outdoors, concerns about ticks increase. But alongside the real risks, many myths are still prevalent – ​​both about where ticks are found and what to do after being bitten. Do ticks really fall from trees, and are they found on every city lawn?

latvia.title: Another attempt required to find Latvia's senior civil servant
latvia.description: A repeat competition will be required for the position of Director of the State Chancellery, Elīna Šverna, communications advisor to Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List), told the LETA newswire.

latvia.title: Temperatures will rise midweek in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasters predict that air temperatures in Latvia will rise in the middle of this week and fall slightly towards the end of the week.

latvia.title: Kulbergs' claims about NGO costs are questionable
latvia.description: Does each meeting between the government and Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs) really cost 18,000 euros, as Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs claims? The Re:Check fact-checking strand investigates.

latvia.title: Employee housing considered by some Latvian businesses
latvia.description: This week, the new “Balticovo” rental apartment block for staff will be officially opened in Iecava. The company has invested more than two million euros in its construction. The new building will help tackle the housing problem, which poses challenges for many employers, Latvian Radio reported on August 3.

latvia.title: Vecmāmiņa pēc slimnīcā pieļautas kļūdas paliek neatgriezeniski sakropļota
latvia.description: Kāda Melburnas vecmāmiņa palikusi ar neatgriezeniskām traumām pēc tam, kad slimnīcas darbinieki sajaukuši viņu ar citu pacienti, kurai bija tāds pats vārds, ziņo ārzemju prese. Debra Bjūkenana (Debra Buchanan) 23. janvārī tika nogādāta Džoanas Kirneres Sieviešu un bērnu slimnīcā (Joan Kirner Women’s and Children’s Hospital), lai veiktu plānveida procedūru – noņemtu vēža skartu ādas veidojumu […]

latvia.title: Pēteris Apinis: Covid–19 strīdi Kapitolija kalnā
latvia.description: Uzrakstīt par Covid–19 pieredzi bez politikas ir turpat vai neiespējami. Arī šo rindu autoram allaž licies vēlams nosaukt atbildīgās politiskās personas, kas Latvijā noteica bērnu mājsēdi, sporta aizliegumus, pannu pirkšanas aizliegumu, kas vakcināciju pārnesa uz krāmu tirgu un kapu svētkiem, kas politizēja vakcināciju līdz antivakcīnu kopienas izveidei un iztērēja neiedomājami daudz Latvijas naudas, pie kam […]

latvia.title: “Tas vēl no padomju laikiem…” Šics uzskata, ka policijā joprojām pastāv savstarpēja piesegšana
latvia.description: Pēdējie skaļie notikumi Valsts policijā, kuros iesaistīti paši likumsargi, sabiedrībā raisījuši jautājumus ne tikai par atsevišķu amatpersonu rīcību, bet arī par to, vai policijas sistēmā nepastāv dziļākas problēmas. Katastrofu medicīnas speciālists un Rīgas domes deputāts Mārtiņš Šics uzskata, ka viena no tām varētu būt savstarpējā piesegšana, kuras saknes meklējamas vēl padomju laikos. latvia.title: Lietuviešu uzņēmējs piedāvā vēl nedzirdētu risinājumu “airBaltic” glābšanai: “”airBaltic” mums nav vienkārši uzņēmums”
latvia.description: “airBaltic” nākotne pēdējā laikā kļuvusi par vienu no skaļākajiem jautājumiem Latvijas valdībā un sabiedrībā, un Baltijas aviācijas nozarē. Kamēr uzņēmums meklē stabilitāti, finanšu līdzekļus un stratēģiskus risinājumus turpmākajai attīstībai, arvien biežāk izskan jautājums, vai “airBaltic” vispār ir iespējams glābt un vai tas Latvijas valstij vispār būtu jādara. Lai gan “airBaltic” ir Latvijas uzņēmums, tā darbība […]

lithuania.title: Elnézést kért a FIFA elnöke, maradhat a posztján
lithuania.description: Gianni Infantino azt tervezte, hogy a FIFA-tornák egyes részesedéseit magánbefektetőknek adják el, de az ötlet nem aratott osztatlan sikert. Most bocsánatot is kért miatta.

lithuania.title: Elnyerte a demokraták szenátorjelöltségét a muszlim, egyiptomi gyökerű Abdul El-Sayed
lithuania.description: Az orvos végzettségű 44 éves jelölt lehet az Egyesült Államok első muszlim vallású szenátora, ha győz a novemberi félidős választáson.

lithuania.title: Bocsánatot kért Gianni Infantino, amiért kiárusította volna a világbajnokságot
lithuania.description: Hibának nevezte saját tervét a FIFA elnöke, aki egyelőre marad a szervezet élén.

lithuania.title: Rémálom a repülőn: 90 métert zuhant a levegőben egy indiai utasszállító
lithuania.description: Legalább 12-en megsérültek, az utastérben burkolati elemek szakadtak le, kitört a pánik. A rémület utáni pillanatokról videó is készült.

lithuania.title: Valerij Zaluzsnijt megkérték, hogy magyarázza meg, amit a NATO-ról mondott, erre elmondta ugyanazt, csak még erősebben
lithuania.description: „A NATO még mindig a második világháború végén kialakított doktrína szerint működik, miközben technológiai szempontból már előrébb járunk.”

lithuania.title: „Mondtam a miniszternek, hogy ugyanilyen gőzössel jártam annak idején dolgozni”
lithuania.description: Három év szünet után újra járnak személyvonatok Komlóra, pedig a város polgármestere korábban a vasútvonal városon belüli szakaszának elbontásáért lobbizott. Bár Vitézy Dávid szimbolikus projektként kezeli az újranyitást, Polics József nem tett le a vasútmentes belvárosról.

lithuania.title: Zelenszkij rendkívüli segítséget kér a NATO-tól: minden nap emberéletek múlnak rajta - Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index csütörtöki hírösszefoglalója
lithuania.description: Oroszország háborúja Ukrajnában – az Index csütörtöki hírösszefoglalója.

lithuania.title: Veszélyes orosz játék a levegőben: példátlanul megugrott a katonai riasztások száma a NATO keleti határán
lithuania.description: A NATO keleti szárnyán júliusban több mint két és félszeresére nőtt a vadászgépek riasztásainak száma az előző év azonos időszakához képest – derül ki a szövetség kelet- és közép-európai egyesített erőinek augusztus 5-i jelentéséből. A növekedés hátterében az orosz katonai repülőgépek egyre gyakoribb, repülési terv és transzponder nélküli megjelenése áll a NATO-tagállamok légterének közelében - közölte a Kyiv Independent .

lithuania.title: Összeesküvést gyanít Zelenszkij: szövetkeztek Ukrajna ellen a NATO tagállamai?
lithuania.description: Elképzelhető, hogy Ukrajna szövetségesei nyomást akarnak gyakorolni Kijevre azzal, hogy szándékosan nem szállítanak több légvédelmi rakétát - mondta Volodimir Zelenszkij ukrán elnök az Ukrinform cikke szerint.

lithuania.title: Súlyos incidens történt egy NATO-bázison: hajszál híján múlt a katasztrófa, ez akár szándékos támadás is lehet
lithuania.description: A lipcsei repülőtéren kedden késő este talált drón robbanószerkezettel volt felszerelve - közölték a német nyomozóhatóságok.

lithuania.title: Znaczny wzrost liczby przechwyceń rosyjskich samolotów nad wschodnią flanką NATO
lithuania.description: Włoski kontyngent, chwilę po przejęciu misji po siłach powietrznych Francji, był zmuszony do interwencji nad Bałtykiem. W ciągu roku liczba poderwań myśliwców NATO do przechwycenia rosyjskich samolotów wzdłuż wschodniej flanki Sojuszu wzrosła o ponad 250 procent - poinformowało Dowództwo Połączonych Sił Powietrznych NATO.

lithuania.title: Česko je logistický uzol NATO, no jeho bojové vozidlá parkujú desiatky kilometrov od svojej základne
lithuania.description: Napriek vyšším výdavkom na obranu zostávajú kľúčové slabiny českej armády prakticky nezmenené, ukazujú dokumenty ministerstva obrany aj kontrolné správy.

lithuania.title: Ukrajina nikdy nevstúpi do NATO, povedal Zalužnyj. Ako chápať vyjadrenie bývalého šéfa ukrajinskej armády?
lithuania.description: Ukrajinské ministerstvo zahraničných vecí odkázalo, že cieľom Kyjiva je naďalej vstup do Aliancie.

lithuania.title: Trei factori care pot amâna instalarea demenţei. Descoperirile făcute de un nou studiu
lithuania.description: Oamenii de ştiinţă susţin că au identificat trei factori de sănătate la vârsta mijlocie care pot amâna instalarea demenţei pentru mai bine de un deceniu. Conform unui studiu, menţinerea unei tensiuni arteriale normale, absenţa diabetului de tip 2 şi renunţarea la fumat între vârstele de 45 şi 65 de ani au fost asociate, în medie, cu aproape 13 ani suplimentari de viaţă fără demenţă.

lithuania.title: Valeri Zalujnîi spune ca de fapt NATO are nevoie de Ucraina: „Să spună sincer, poate lupta cu Rusia fără experiența noastră?”
lithuania.description: Ambasadorul Ucrainei în Regatul Unit, fostul comandant-şef al Forţelor Armate ale Ucrainei, Valeri Zalujnîi, a dat miercuri explicații cu privire la declarația sa de acum două zile, când a spus că Ucraina nu ar fi avantajată de aderarea la NATO, relatează Evropeiska Pravda şi Interfax-Ucraina.

lithuania.title: Volodimir Zelenski, discuție cu șeful NATO. Despre ce au vorbit cei doi lideri: „Este bine informat cu privire la amenințări”
lithuania.description: Președintele ucrainean Volodimir Zelenski a declarat miercuri că a discutat cu secretarul general al NATO, Mark Rutte, despre posibilitatea de a obține mai multe rachete de interceptare pentru apărarea aeriană, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Al treilea tunel folosit de migranți descoperit la granița dintre Lituania și Belarus
lithuania.description: Lituania a descoperit un nou tunel, al treilea identificat recent, prin care migranţii urmau să fie introduşi ilegal în această ţară dinspre Belarus, au anunţat miercuri autorităţile de la Vilnius, informează Agerpres, care citează dpa.

lithuania.title: Spania se teme pentru exclavele Ceuta și Melilla. Cine ar sări în ajutorul Madridului în cazul unei acțiuni a Marocului
lithuania.description: Valul de migranți care a ajuns în exclavele spaniole Ceuta și Melilla a reaprins temerile Madridului privind securitatea teritoriilor sale din Africa de Nord. În contextul în care Marocul își intensifică revendicările asupra celor două orașe autonome, oficialii spanioli se întreabă cât de solid ar fi sprijinul aliaților din NATO și al Statelor Unite în cazul unei escaladări a tensiunilor, arată Politico, într-o analiză.

lithuania.title: Incident de securitate: o dronă a zburat în apropierea unui avion ucrainean pe aeroportul din Leipzig/Halle
lithuania.description: La scurt timp după miezul nopții, o alertă de securitate a fost declanșată pe aeroportul Leipzig/Halle. O dronă fusese observată în incintă. Mai multe detalii au apărut acum: potrivit unui purtător de cuvânt al NATO, o dronă a fost observată în apropierea unei aeronave ucrainene, relatează focus.de.

lithuania.title: Ucraina așteaptă undă verde din partea SUA pentru producția rachetelor Patriot. Washingtonul ezită
lithuania.description: Rafalele de rachete balistice lansate de Rusia au determinat Kievul să încerce cu disperare să înceapă producția propriilor rachete de interceptare Patriot, însă, în ciuda acordului inițial al lui Trump pentru o licență de producție, SUA nu au oferit încă nicio certitudine. Este puțin probabil ca Statele Unite să ajungă la un acord cu Ucraina privind producția comună de rachete de interceptare Patriot înainte de această iarnă, a declarat luni ambasadorul SUA la NATO, Matthew Whitaker, alimentând incertitudinea cu privire la cel mai critic aspect al apărării aeriene a Kievului, arată Euronews.

lithuania.title: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei ucrainene solicită demiterea comandantului Forțelor Medicale. „Omul lui Sîrskîi”
lithuania.description: Noul Comandant-șef al Armatei Ucrainei, Mihailo Drapatîi, a înaintat o cerere prin care solicită demiterea lui Anatolii Kazmirchuk, comandantul Forțelor Medicale.

lithuania.title: Abrudean, apel către senatori: De votul pe legea integrității și strategia pentru biodiversitate depind 3,48 miliarde de euro din PNRR
lithuania.description: Președintele Senatului Mircea Abrudean le cere senatorilor să adopte în această săptămână proiectele privind strategia națională pentru biodiversitate și legea integrității. Liberalul avertizează că de îndeplinirea acestor jaloane din Planul Național de Redresare și Reziliență (PNRR) depinde accesarea a aproximativ 3,48 miliarde de euro.

lithuania.title: Consilierul pe securitate națională de la Cotroceni și șeful Armatei au fost primiți la Pentagon. Mesaj privind NATO 3.0
lithuania.description: Subsecretarul de stat de la Departamentul de Război al Statelor Unite, Elbridge Colby, a anunțat marți că a avut o întrevedere la Pentagon cu consilierul pentru securitate națională de la Cotroceni, Marius Lazurca, căruia i-a prezentat în avans abordarea SUA privind „Europe Posture Review”. La întrunire a participat și șeful Armatei României, generalul Gheorghiță Vlad.

lithuania.title: Tanczos Barna: S-a format o majoritate ciudată pentru legea ANI. E inadmisibil să facem amendamente cu țintă la o persoană
lithuania.description: Legea ANI, adoptată luni de Camera Deputaţilor şi aflată pe ordinea de zi a sesiunea extraordinare a Senatului, care e Cameră decizională, a devenit „un concurs de mesaje politice şi mai puţin un act de legiferare bine gândit”, a declarat marți, la RFI, vicepremierul Tanczos Barna. „E inadmisibil să facem legi pe persoane fizice”, mai declară senatorul UDMR.

lithuania.title: Un pilot ucrainean a urmărit racheta rusească de tip KH-101 care a explodat în Polonia. De ce nu a doborât-o
lithuania.description: Un pilot al Forțelor Aeriene Ucrainene, care se afla în „urmărire directă” a unei rachete rusești de tip Kh-101 care s-a prăbușit în Polonia în luna iulie, a fost nevoit să se întoarcă la graniță din cauza procedurilor NATO, a dezvăluit viceministrul polonez al Apărării, relatează TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Cum explică Cosmin Marinescu, viceguvernator al BNR, reconfirmarea ratingului României de către Fitch
lithuania.description: Viceguvernatorul BNR Cosmin Marinescu susține că decizia agenției Fitch de a reconfirma ratingul de țară al României este justificată de evoluția principalilor indicatori macroeconomici. Într-o postare publicată pe site-ul său, acesta a invocat reducerea deficitului bugetar, perspectiva de scădere a inflației, estimările privind revenirea creșterii economice, nivelul rezervelor internaționale și soliditatea sistemului bancar drept principalele argumente care au stat la baza evaluării agenției de rating.

lithuania.title: Leedu kodanik mõisteti Kaliningradis spionaaži eest pikaks vangi
lithuania.description: Venemaa Kaliningradi eksklaavi kohus mõistis oblastis elanud Leedu kodaniku spionaaži eest 13 aastaks ja kuueks kuuks vangi, teatas kohtu pressiteenistus kolmapäeval.

lithuania.title: RAINER SAKS ⟩ Ukraina valis endale Vene armeest hävitamiseks väga keerulise sihtmärgi
lithuania.description: Ukraina president teatas, et Ukraina sõjaväelaste eesmärk on hävitada Vene armee ballistiliste rakettide Iskander laskeseadeldised ning et Ukraina sõjaväelased teevad selleks ettevalmistusi, kirjutab julgeolekuekspert Rainer Saks (Parempoolsed).

lithuania.title: WSJ ⟩ Putin tuunib sõjamasinat, et tuure üles võtta
lithuania.description: Venemaa president Vladimir Putin nimetas ametisse armee uue droonitiiva juhataja ning paigutas ringi käputäie komandöre olukorras, kus Moskva üritab elavdada oma jukerdavat kampaaniat Ukrainas.

lithuania.title: Latvian Minister in the soup after lecturing Spain on immigration
lithuania.description: Latvian Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) appears to have annoyed key EU and NATO partner Spain, reports Latvian Television.

lithuania.title: “Šis ir pavisam cita līmeņa drauds!” Eksperti brīdina par bīstamu eskalāciju Eiropā

lithuania.title: “Karstasinīgie igauņi…” Lavrovs atkal draud Baltijas valstīm pēc runām par NATO kodolatturēšanas spēkiem
lithuania.description: Krievijas ārlietu ministrs Sergejs Lavrovs kārtējo reizi nācis klajā ar asiem paziņojumiem par Baltijas valstīm, apgalvojot, ka tās kļuvušas par galveno spiediena instrumentu pret Krieviju. Viņš asi reaģēja uz pēdējā laikā izskanējušajām diskusijām par iespējamu NATO kodolatturēšanas spēju izvietošanu alianses austrumu flangā. Par to vēsta Krievijas mediji. Lavrovs apgalvoja, ka Latvija, Lietuva un Igaunija tagad […]

lithuania.title: Kā asa sižeta filmā! Migranti pa pašu raktu tuneli iekļūst Lietuvā un uzbrūk robežsargiem
lithuania.description: Nelegālo migrantu grupa jūlija beigās uzbruka Lietuvas robežsargiem pēc tam, kad migranti bija iekļuvuši valstī Lazdiju rajonā caur tuneli uz robežas ar Baltkrieviju, trešdien vēstīja portāls “Delfi.lt”. lithuania.title: Metų rekordas: greitkelyje Vilnius–Klaipėda sustabdė sunkvežimį su 2,4 mln. eurų vertės neteisėtu kroviniu
lithuania.description: Ties Kryžkalniu MKT pareigūnai sulaikė didžiulę nelegalių rūkalų siuntą: iš Latvijos įvažiavusiame vilkike rasta 2,4 mln. eurų vertės cigarečių.

lithuania.title: „Maskvoje ir Sankt Peterburge vaikščios meškos“: Ukrainos deputatas įvardijo silpniausią Rusijos vietą
lithuania.description: Sausį Maskvoje ir Sankt Peterburge vaikščios meškos, nes ten taps neįmanoma gyventi, jeigu lapkritį ir gruodį Ukraina pradės naują smūgių kampaniją prieš Rusijos kompresorines dujų stotis, „Apostrof TV“ laidoje pareiškė Ukrainos parlamento narys iš frakcijos „Tautos tarnas“ Olehas Dunda.

lithuania.title: Trumpas pagrasino „medžiokle“ „išdavikams“, skelbiantiems, kad JAV ištuštino savo šaudmenų atsargas
lithuania.description: JAV prezidentas Donaldas Trumpas ketvirtadienį pareiškė, kad šalis turi milžiniškas šaudmenų atsargas, o tiems, kurie teigia kitaip, pagrasino laisvės atėmimo bausmėmis.

lithuania.title: Zelenskis kirto sąjungininkams: siekiate priversti Ukrainą tai padaryti
lithuania.description: Trečiadienį Ukrainos gynybos pajėgoms nepavyko numušti nė vienos Rusijos paleistos balistinės raketos. Savo ruožtu prezidentas Volodymyras Zelenskis netiesiogiai apkaltino sąjungininkus, kad jų delsimas arba nenoras tai daryti lemia „siaubingas aukas“.

lithuania.title: Terorizmu kaltinamas Eldaras Salmanovas teisme pareiškė esąs pacisfistas ir mylintis taiką
lithuania.description: Vilniaus apygardos teisme ketvirtadienį nagrinėjant į užsienį išsiųstų padegamųjų siuntų bylą, buvo toliau apklausiami kaltinamieji.

lithuania.title: „Čekiukų“ ikiteisminiuose tyrimuose įtarimai pareikšti Jonavos, Birštono merų patarėjoms
lithuania.description: „Čekiukų“ ikiteisminiuose tyrimuose dėl tarybos narių veiklai skirtų lėšų panaudojimo įtarimai pareikšti septyniems esamiems ir buvusiems savivaldos politikams, tarp jų – Jonavos rajono mero patarėjai, buvusiai tarybos narei Birutei Gailienei ir Birštono merės patarėjai, dabartinei Prienų rajono tarybos narei Simonai Vaicekauskaitei-Šalčei.

lithuania.title: Buvusią ambasadorę JAV Stefanišyną sutiko paleisti už užstatą: suma – milžiniška
lithuania.description: Ukrainos Aukščiausiasis antikorupcijos teismas buvusiai Ukrainos ambasadorei Jungtinėse Valstijose Olhai Stefanišynai paskyrė 6 mln. grivinų (116,29 tūkst. eurų) užstatą, skelbia pilietinė organizacija „Transparency International Ukraine“.

lithuania.title: Istorinis sprendimas: Švedija perduoda Ukrainai konfiskuotą Rusijos laivą
lithuania.description: Švedijos Aukščiausiasis Teismas paliko galioti sprendimą, leidžiantį konfiskuoti ir perduoti Ukrainai Rusijos „šešėlinio laivyno“ laivą, gabenusį vogtus grūdus, ketvirtadienį skelbia portalas „The Kyiv Independent“.

lithuania.title: Per pirmąjį šių metų pusmetį Lietuvoje įregistruota 6,2 tūkstančio santuokų
lithuania.description: Pirmąjį 2026 metų pusmetį mūsų šalyje įregistruotos 6204 santuokos, praneša Teisingumo ministerija.

lithuania.title: „Kvieskit policiją!“: prieš rungtynes tarp „Žalgirio“ ir „Hajduk“ klubų Vilniuje jau pakvipo paraku – nufilmuoti grėsmingi vaizdai
lithuania.description: UEFA Konferencijų lygos trečiojo atrankos rato rungtynės tarp „Žalgirio“ ir „Hajduk“ (Kroatija) klubų Vilniuje vyks rugpjūčio 6 d., jau šįvakar. Išvakarėse Vilniaus senamiestyje nufilmuoti barbariški vaizdai. Įtariama, kad seniausia aktyviųjų futbolo sirgalių grupe Europoje savo vadinanti „Torcida“ jau parodė savo polinkius bei agresiją.
